main_question: Do price coefficient signs survive when each equation uses only one excluded IV?
decision_rule: No overidentification test; use only as sign robustness.

main_question: Do signs improve after removing common trends with year-over-year changes?
decision_rule: Prioritize if demand price is negative, mortgage-rate change is negative, and permit growth is positive.

main_question: Do signs improve before pandemic and rapid-rate-hike distortions?
decision_rule: Prioritize if signs are more theory-consistent than full-sample levels.

main_question: Does supply respond more clearly to lagged prices?
decision_rule: Use to explain insignificant same-month supply price coefficient if lagged price is positive.
